title: ERP file formats, shared definitions (version 1)
description: Building blocks shared by the CSV, fixed-width, JSON and XML formats. Not a format by itself.

name.description: A name for people and error messages: a file, a record type or a column.

path.description: Where a value sits in the document: property names joined by dots, such as product.gtin. A path never goes through an array.

textEncoding.description: Character encoding of the file. utf-8 is read with or without a byte order mark (see bom).

bom.description: Write a UTF-8 byte order mark at the start of the file. Only with utf-8; a reader accepts a file with or without one.

lineEnding.description: End of every line written, the last one included. Readers accept CRLF and LF.

decimalMark.description: Character between the whole part and the decimals of a decimal number.

column.description: One value of a record. Exactly one of field, documentField and value says where it comes from.

field.description: Path of the value in the item of the record (or in the document, for a record without source).

documentField.description: Path of the value in the document, repeated on every record. When it changes from one record to the next, a reader starts a new document.

value.description: A constant, such as the code of the record type. Written as is; a reader checks it and uses it to tell record types apart.

type.description: string: copied as is. decimal: a decimal string of the document, written with the decimal mark and scale of the format. integer: a whole number, read as a JSON number.

groupBy.description: For a field of a record with a source: records that follow each other with the same value belong to one document, and a reader starts a new document when it changes. A documentField always groups this way.

required.description: The value must be present and not empty, when writing and when reading.

scale.description: Decimal numbers only: number of decimals written. Missing zeros are added; a value with more non-zero decimals is an error, never rounded.

recordType.description: One kind of line of a file. A record without source is written once per document from the document itself; a record with a source is written once per item of that array.

source.description: Path of the array whose items give one record each, such as lines.
